corpusFragments.title: Polk County Fire Marshal — Mandatory commercial development plan review authority for unincorporated Polk County. No specific IBC/IFC edition formally adopted or published by the county.
Polk County Permit Department — Commercial and residential development permits for unincorporated Polk County. Address: 602 E Church St Suite 141, Livingston TX 77351.
Polk County Floodplain Administration — Elevation certificates and floodplain development permits required for development in mapped flood hazard areas.
Polk County OSSF/Septic — Polk County Health and Safety Code Order governing on-site sewage facilities. Required for development outside municipal sewer service areas.

contradictionPatternFragments.description: Polk County (unincorporated) has not formally published an adopted IBC/IFC edition. Any project document citing a specific code version for unincorporated Polk County work should be flagged — governing code version must be confirmed with the Polk County Fire Marshal before compliance determination.
